sources: https://www.mantonmi.org/ (City of Manton site: no campground page)
https://www.mantonmi.org/documents/20240129_Manton_PR_Plan_Report_Adopted.pdf (City of Manton Parks & Recreation Plan, adopted 2024-01-29)

hookups.source: City of Manton Parks & Recreation Plan 2024, p.20 ('85 Campsites ... 37 with full hook-ups, 48 with electric and water') + Firefly booking page (every RV site unit labelled '30 AMP'; classes Full Hookup, Water/Electric Only, Water Only, Rustic), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: City of Manton Parks & Recreation Plan 2024, p.20 ('85 Campsites; several of them are handicap accessible'; p.16 'all services used by campers at the 85 sites'), read 2026-10-22. The Firefly page lists 88 RV site units (numbered to 90).

facilities.source: City of Manton Parks & Recreation Plan 2024, p.20 ('Dump station for RV waste', 'Restrooms', 'Showers with hot water', 'Washer and dryer') + Firefly amenity filter ('Washer/Dryer available for a fee', 'WiFi'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Booked on the city's Firefly page; in late October 2026 it took no dates past Oct 15, 2026 (2027 not yet open).

booking.source: https://app.fireflyreservations.com/Reserve/Property/LakeBillingsCampground (RV Site / Tent Site units; max search date 10-15-2026; 'This unit cannot be reserved this far in the future'), read 2026-10-22

note: City of Manton park on Lake Billings (14 acres), within walking distance of downtown Manton: 37 full-hookup and 48 water/electric sites, beach, fishing, playground, tennis courts, pavilions. The city has no web page for it; it books on its Firefly page. --Claude
summary: No city web page for the campground; the city's 2024 Parks & Recreation Plan and its Firefly booking page: 85 sites (37 full hookup, 48 water/electric), 30 A, showers, restrooms, dump station, washer/dryer, Wi-Fi. Added electric 30, facilities, booking (Firefly); hookups/sites now manual. No rate posted anywhere official (Firefly shows no prices with 2026 closed and 2027 not open), so fees stay empty. Season (Apr 15 - Oct 15, derived) not stated by the city; left. Note rewritten without the michigan.org remark.
flags: Website: the entry links a michigan.org tourism listing. The City of Manton's site (https://www.mantonmi.org/) has no page for the campground; the city's own booking page is https://app.fireflyreservations.com/Reserve/Property/LakeBillingsCampground (Firefly, 'Lake Billings Campground'), which should replace it. Phone 231-824-6454 is not on either city page (Firefly shows none).
No 2024+ rate from the city: the Firefly page shows no prices (2026 booking closed at Oct 15, 2027 not open) and the city's plan gives none.
